title: Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst
description:
Position Type: Full-time

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Schedule: Mon-Fri, EST

About the Company

Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels.

About the Role

Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues.

You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces.

  • Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers.

  • Classify sellers and verify their authorization status.

  • Identify MAP, distribution, territory, and marketplace compliance issues.

  • Monitor unauthorized use of logos, images, trademarks, and product content.

  • Collect evidence such as URLs, screenshots, seller information, and product details.

  • Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records.

  • Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports.

  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics.

  • Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes.

Competencies and Qualifications


Must-Have

  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online research, e-commerce, compliance, or a related field.

  • Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables.

  • Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.

  • Strong written English and reporting skills.

  • Ability to work independently and follow SOPs.

  • Familiarity with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.

Nice-to-Have

  • Brand protection or marketplace compliance experience.

  • Experience with PROWL, Helium 10, Salesforce, or similar tools.

  • Knowledge of MAP, distribution, or channel compliance.

  • Experience with dashboards and reporting.

  • Experience using AI research and translation tools.

Key Qualities

  • Detail-oriented

  • Analytical

  • Investigative

  • Highly organized

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work â Work from anywhere in the Philippines.

  • Career Growth Opportunities â Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning.

  • Collaborative & Innovative Team â Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence.

Application Process

We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and weâre here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible.

The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us.

title: Engineer Estimator
description:
Crystalia Glass LLC is a leading provider of premium glass products, dedicated to transforming spaces with elegance and sophistication. With a commitment to craftsmanship and innovation, we specialize in designing and manufacturing high-quality glass solutions for residential and commercial projects.

Founded in 2017 in New York, the company has expanded its presence with offices in Los Angeles, Florida, and Texas. As a nationwide company, we serve clients across America, offering our signature glass products and services to diverse markets.

Following consistent annual growth of 70-80% and with even more ambitious plans ahead, we are expanding our recruitment team and looking for a Cost Engineer-Estimator to help drive our continued success.

Employment Type:

  • Full-time, 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM, New York time
  • Remote work.

Responsibilities:

  • Review architectural drawings and submitted quotes to determine suitable installation options for our systems, including glass, aluminum, and steel partitions
  • Perform precise take-offs for all door and partition openings based on architectural and shop drawings
  • Read and interpret door schedules and hardware sets to ensure accurate product selection and full compatibility
  • Communicate effectively with the sales team to clarify project scope, technical requirements, and deadlines
  • Request necessary documentation, including compliance and regulatory certifications, as needed
  • Prepare detailed quotes that clearly define included materials, scope of work, exclusions, and any relevant assumptions or conditions
  • Identify and correct technical errors made by sales managers and propose appropriate alternatives or solutions

Requirements

  • Technical degree in Mechanical or Civil/Structural Engineering
  • Strong spatial thinking and technical problem-solving skills
  • Proven experience with quantity take-offs from construction and mechanical drawings
  • Confident in reading and interpreting:
  • Civil and mechanical drawings Hardware sets and layouts
  • Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Basic formulas
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work independently
  • Comfortable working with scaled PDFs (e.g., in Adobe Acrobat)
  • Languages: Russian (fluent), English (Upper-intermediate B2)
  • Available to work full-time aligned with EST timezone (8:30AM-5:00PM)

Benefits

  • Clear opportunities for career development and salary increase
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Work with a diverse and talented group of professionals
  • Supportive and innovative work environment
  • Paid days off and Sick leave

Please note: this is a fully remote, full-time position with a schedule from 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM (New York time).

The candidate should have strong written and verbal English communication skills (B2 level or higher) and a technical degree or proven experience as a Engineer / Estimator.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Notice

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

This job description is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with the job of the incumbent. About Cellsor

Cameras digitized vision. Microphones digitized sound. Smell is the one major sense we still can't capture, measure or transmit reliably. Cellsor is building the sensor that changes that.

We replicate the mammalian olfactory epithelium outside the body – living olfactory tissue on microelectrode arrays – and read it out with machine learning. The result is a sensor that detects chemicals the way a nose does, with the breadth and sensitivity that conventional gas sensors lack. Applications span flavor and fragrance, defense and security, medical diagnostics, food quality and industrial monitoring.

title: Agentic Platform Engineer (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it.

About the Role

As one of our first platform engineers, you will build the foundations that every product feature depends on: the gateway and router, usage and billing systems, customer key management and the European infrastructure underneath.

Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows.

You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together. You will also work alongside our founding AI engineer on evals, embeddings and open-weight model serving, bringing platform engineering depth to the ML side of the product.

Agentic engineering is central to how we work. You will operate in an agentic way by default, using coding agents as a core part of how you design, build, test and ship software. You'll develop the harnesses and workflows that allow you to delegate and parallelise work effectively, increasing what a small engineering team can deliver. This requires strong coding fundamentals and the judgement to review, challenge and take responsibility for everything that reaches production.

There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and value people who take initiative and see things through.

What You’ll Work On

Your first area of ownership will depend on your strengths and our priorities. From there, you will contribute across the platform as it develops.

  • Gateway and routing: build a consistent API across model providers, with reliable streaming, fallbacks and safe handling of retries and provider errors.

  • Agentic engineering workflows: build and refine the harnesses, tooling and workflows that enable coding agents to work effectively across the development lifecycle, from implementation and testing to debugging and deployment.

  • Cost optimisation: develop caching, history compression and model selection, measuring savings while keeping estimated costs distinct from actual spend.

  • Usage and billing: build accurate accounting for model calls, usage reports, plan entitlements and invoice reconciliation.

  • Agent infrastructure and integrations: support tool calls, cost limits, human approvals and runs that can recover safely from interruptions, alongside connectors for services such as Gmail, Slack and calendars.

  • Tenancy and secrets: maintain workspace isolation, secure authentication and encrypted customer key management.

  • European infrastructure and model serving: build and operate our cloud infrastructure, including the GPU capacity used to serve open-weight models.

  • Production reliability: make systems observable, migrations reversible and releases safe, with tests that protect data integrity and logs that keep customer content and secrets private.

The platform will evolve quickly. You will need to move comfortably between improving what exists and learning enough about a new problem to build the next piece well.

Our Stack

Our backend is built in Python, with a TypeScript frontend in a shared monorepo.

  • Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic and LiteLLM.

  • Data and queues: Postgres with row-level security and pgvector, Redis and arq.

  • Frontend: Next.js, React and TypeScript.

  • Cloud and infrastructure: Scaleway, Terraform and Kubernetes for GPU workloads.

  • Auth and secrets: Zitadel, Secret Manager and KMS.

  • Observability and testing: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Sentry, pytest and testcontainers, alongside frontend testing tools.

You should be comfortable with the core backend technologies and ready to learn the rest as the work requires.

About You

You enjoy the craft of engineering and the responsibility of seeing your work used in production. Faced with an unclear problem, you can identify what matters, make sensible trade-offs and carry a solution through to release without someone planning every step. You naturally look for ways to multiply your output through agentic workflows, rather than approaching every engineering task as something to execute manually.

We are looking for:

  • Experience building and operating production systems: several years of backend engineering with real users, typically three to six, and meaningful ownership of what you shipped.

  • Strong Python fundamentals: confidence with async code, typing and testing. TypeScript experience is a plus.

  • Agentic engineering as a default way of working: you have hands-on experience using coding agents as a core part of your engineering workflow. You know how to break down problems, delegate and parallelise tasks, provide the right context and build effective agentic workflows. Crucially, you have the technical depth to review, debug and take ownership of the resulting code.

  • Platform engineering depth: practical experience with Postgres, Redis, queues, networking and Terraform. Kubernetes experience is useful, particularly for our GPU infrastructure.

  • Sound engineering judgement: clear APIs, tenant isolation, data integrity, partial failure and safe rollouts. You can explain both your decisions and what you chose to leave out.

  • A working understanding of ML systems: familiarity with LLMs, embeddings, evals, model serving and fine-tuning. Experience with LLM APIs, streaming and token costs is a strong plus.

  • A disciplined approach to measurement: you benchmark changes, question assumptions and use evidence to understand whether an improvement holds up.

  • Initiative and drive: you enjoy getting deep into a problem, finding a way forward and putting in the work to make it happen.

  • This is an experienced individual-contributor role, with ownership of the capabilities you build and close collaboration across the founding team.

  • Fluent English is required; German is a plus.

Why Join

At this stage, platform engineering decisions have a direct influence on the product and how quickly the team can build it. You will work close to the founder and CTO, with room to shape the systems you own and see the results of your work first-hand.

The challenge spans AI infrastructure, distributed systems, security and cost efficiency. You will build across those boundaries, take real responsibility early and receive a meaningful equity package in the company you help develop.

We are competing with teams that have more people, more funding and an earlier start. Our approach depends on technical depth, focused decisions and the drive to turn them into working software. We believe agentic engineering can fundamentally change what a small, technically strong team is capable of building, and we're looking for people who want to push that approach forward. For someone who enjoys a demanding build, close collaboration and visible impact, there is a lot to get involved in.

This is a full-time role, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible.

title: Senior Product Manager | Reporting (f/m/d)
description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join bunch’s Reporting team. You’ll own the products and workflows that turn fund and portfolio data into correct, trusted reporting that’s ready to send to investors.

You’ll work at the heart of how fund managers communicate performance and activity to their investors. That means building intuitive reporting experiences and report-generation capabilities customers can trust.

As Senior Product Manager, Reporting Platform, you will:

  • Own key parts of our reporting product and its workflows end-to-end

  • Make sure the numbers investors see are right, from the data fund managers enter, through the calculations, to the final reports and the LP portal

  • Drive product decisions that balance accuracy, compliance and usability

  • Partner closely with engineering, design and operations to deliver a system customers can rely on

This role focuses on the Reporting side of the platform. Typical areas include:

  • Portfolio data capture: how fund managers record investments, valuations and portfolio events like follow-ons, conversions and exits, with a strong focus on intuitive UI/UX, data quality and completeness

  • The calculation layer between fund accounting and investor reporting: turning the fund’s books and portfolio valuations into correct investor numbers, with checks that tie them together

  • Report generation workflows: quarterly and annual packages, capital account statements and PDFs ready to send to investors

  • Configuration and customisation: templates, branding, disclosures, and language and currency formatting

  • Data readiness and correctness for reports: validation, completeness checks and auditability

  • Distribution and delivery: review and approval flows, delivery to investors, and access controls

  • Observability for reporting runs: errors, retries, performance and transparency for customers

Top Responsibilities

  • Drive roadmap and execution for reporting workflows and the reporting experiences customers see

  • Translate domain requirements into clear product specs (inputs → transformations → outputs) with strong edge-case handling

  • Partner with engineering to define the right building blocks for scalable report generation (templates, data contracts, versioning)

  • Collaborate with design to make complex reporting setup and review flows intuitive and fast

  • Work with fund accounting, operations and customer-facing teams to identify friction, ensure correctness and improve time-to-report

  • Define and track success metrics across adoption, report quality, operational efficiency and reliability

  • Maintain a high bar for data integrity, traceability and customer trust

About You

  • 7+ years of product management experience building B2B fintech products

  • Strong product execution skills: shipping, iteration loops, prioritization and stakeholder alignment

  • A solid grasp of financial reporting basics: how they work and why every number has to trace back to a source. Experience from accounting, banking, payments, treasury or financial data products all counts

  • Ability to turn complex requirements into simple product surfaces and crisp product logic

  • Analytical mindset: you can define metrics, investigate root causes and make data-informed tradeoffs

  • Excellent communication: you write clear specs and collaborate well with technical and non-technical partners

  • Experience working closely with engineering on systems that need reliability, monitoring and rigor on edge cases

  • Nice to have: exposure to fund or investment reporting (NAV, capital accounts, fees, IRR, TVPI, DPI). You don’t need a private markets background. We’ll teach you, and you’ll work every day with our fund accounting experts

Workplace & Benefits

  • Competitive salary plus equity

  • Customizable benefits package (wellbeing, sport, mobility, food and more)

  • 28 days of vacation, plus 2 company days and local public holidays

  • Hybrid setup with 2 days a week in the office

  • Up to 4 remote calendar weeks a year

  • A great tech and work setup

  • Work with a diverse team of 140+ bunchies from 40+ countries, with leaders who are best-in-class in their domains

Hiring process

  • First interview with the People team (20 min) to get to know bunch and explore whether what we’re offering matches what you’re looking for

  • Hiring manager interview with our VP of Product (45 min) to discuss your experience, your approach and your fit for the role

  • Product case interview with our Product & Design team (60 min) to show your product thinking, communication and execution style

  • Stakeholder interviews (3 x 30 min) with members of Operations, Engineering and our Founders to align on vision and expectations

Curious to learn more?

Get a feel for who we are, how we work, and what we’re building:

  • About bunch – Our mission, product, and journey so far

  • Case Studies – About those who already build on bunch

  • Gathering insights – Our latest bunch of blog posts

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

title: Projektmanager:in Operations und Partnerprojekte (all genders)
description:
Täglich fahren Millionen Autos durch Deutschland, und in den meisten bleibt Platz ungenutzt. Wir ändern das.

MUVN ist ein digitaler Transportmarktplatz. Wir bringen Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen und Unternehmen zusammen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Günstiger, versichert, ohne Umweg.

Wir bauen gerade an mehreren Dingen gleichzeitig: einem neuen Produkt für gewerbliche Versender, Piloten mit großen Marken, neuen Strecken, Integrationen. An jedem dieser Themen arbeiten mehrere Menschen aus mehreren Bereichen, und keiner von ihnen hat den vollen Überblick über alle anderen.

Genau dafür gibt es diese Stelle. Du weißt zu jeder Zeit, wo jedes Projekt steht, was als Nächstes ansteht und wo es gerade klemmt. Eine Frage zum aktuellen Sprint, und du kannst sie beantworten. Eine Frage zu einem Partnerprojekt, und du gehst auf die Leute zu und sorgst dafür, dass am Tag X alles steht.

Du bist kein Product Owner und musst nicht entwickeln können. Du musst verstehen, worum es geht, grob einschätzen können, was etwas bedeutet, und Dinge über die Ziellinie bringen.

Hierfür suchen wir dich ab dem 15.11.2026 als Verstärkung für unser Team in Köln 🚀

Aufgaben

  • Überblick über alle Projekte

Du führst die Timeline über Marktplatz, unser Produkt für gewerbliche Versender, Integrationen und Partnerprojekte. Status, nächster Meilenstein, offene Entscheidungen, Risiken. Alles an einem Ort, aktuell, und für jeden im Team in zwei Minuten auffindbar.

  • Themen aktiv vorantreiben

Du wartest nicht auf Statusmeldungen, du holst sie dir. Freundlich und hartnäckig, bis erledigt wirklich erledigt heißt.

  • Abhängigkeiten und Termine

Du erkennst früh, wo sich Themen gegenseitig blockieren, über Tech, Marketing, Operations und externe Partner hinweg. Und du eskalierst konkret: nicht "das wird knapp", sondern "wenn X bis Freitag nicht steht, verschiebt sich Y um zwei Wochen".

  • Launches und Piloten

Du planst und begleitest den Start neuer Produkte, Features und Partnerprojekte. Wer liefert was bis wann, was muss am Tag X stehen, was lernen wir danach. Und du baust Checklisten, die beim zweiten Mal besser funktionieren als beim ersten.

  • Schnittstelle zu Tech

Wir sind ein technisches Produkt, deshalb hängt vieles an unserem CTO. Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen ihm und den laufenden Projekten. Du verstehst genug vom Thema, um in einem Kunden- oder Partnergespräch grob einzuschätzen, was etwas bedeutet, und um die richtige Rückfrage zu stellen.

  • Ziele und Rhythmus

Du hältst den Takt: Zyklen, Check-ins, Reviews, sichtbarer Fortschritt. Die Ziele setzen die Gründer:innen und die Verantwortlichen. Dass sie nachgehalten werden, liegt bei dir.

  • Meetings und Entscheidungen

Für deine projektübergreifenden Runden bereitest du vor und nach: Agenda, Unterlagen, Ergebnisse, To-dos mit Verantwortlichem und Datum. Entscheidungen dokumentierst du so, dass sie zwei Wochen später nicht neu verhandelt werden.

  • Externe Partner

Agenturen, Pilotpartner, Dienstleister. Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit: Lieferungen, Termine, Feedbackschleifen.

  • Prozesse und KI

Wiederkehrendes standardisierst du mit Vorlagen und Checklisten. Du arbeitest KI-first: Statusberichte, Protokolle, Recherche und Dokumentation baust du mit KI. Was dabei rauskommt, prüfst du. Die Richtigkeit gehört dir, nicht dem Tool.

Qualifikation

Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Programmmanagement, gerne in einem Startup, einer Agentur oder einem digitalen Produktumfeld. Du hast schon einmal ein Projekt mit mehreren Beteiligten und einem harten Termin über die Ziellinie gebracht, ohne selbst die fachliche Arbeit gemacht zu haben.

Du bist nah dran an digitalen Produkten. Tiefe Technikkenntnisse brauchst du nicht, aber du musst Sachzusammenhänge verstehen und grob einschätzen können, was ein Wunsch bedeutet, bevor du ihn zusagst.

Was uns genauso wichtig ist wie Organisation:

  • Du machst dir kritische Gedanken. Was verstehen unsere Nutzer nicht? Was macht der Markt besser als wir? Was könnten wir mit kleinen Impulsen schärfer machen?

  • Du fragst nach, auch dreimal, auch wenn es unangenehm wird.

  • Du hast Mut. Du sagst es, wenn du etwas für falsch hältst, auch wenn drei Gründer:innen im Raum sitzen.

  • Du lieferst zum zugesagten Datum oder verhandelst vorher neu, nicht hinterher.

  • Du wartest nicht darauf, dass jemand dir sagt, was zu tun ist.

Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Unser Entwicklungsteam arbeitet auf Englisch.

Driven people > Degrees. Dein Mindset zählt mehr als dein Abschluss.

Benefits

  • Echte Entscheidungen: du entscheidest den Weg zum Termin, die Eskalation und wann etwas fertig ist

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründer:innen: kein HR-Filter, keine Hierarchie dazwischen

  • Du siehst alles: Marktplatz, Produkt, Partner, Zahlen. Bei uns gibt es keine Ebene, die für dich zu ist.

  • KI-first im Alltag: wir arbeiten mit modernen Tools und zeigen dir, wie

  • Karriereperspektive: die Rolle wächst mit der Firma, in DACH und Europa

  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Büro in Hamburg, Homeoffice nach Absprache

  • Offsites mit dem Team: Gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr

  • Free MUVN Rides: Für dich entstehen keinerlei Nutzungsgebühren

  • Corporate Benefits: Rabatte in hunderten Onlineshops

Mehr Infos zu unseren Benefits und unseren Firmenwerten findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und eine halbe Seite dazu:

Schau dir unsere App oder unsere Website an und sag uns eine Sache, die du besser machen würdest. Was verstehen Nutzer deiner Meinung nach nicht, und woran machst du das fest?

Es gibt keine richtige Antwort. Uns interessiert, wie du hinschaust.

Oder schick ein kurzes Video dazu. Macht uns ehrlich gesagt noch neugieriger als jedes Anschreiben.

So läuft es ab: erstes Gespräch mit Katharina, dann eine Session an einem echten Projekt aus unserem Alltag, dann Kennenlernen mit dem Team.

Fragen? Direkt an Katharina.

Let's get it muvn. 🚀

Jobbeschreibung

Warum gibt es diese Rolle - und warum jetzt?

Lovebetter wächst in eine neue Phase. Wir haben eine klare Mission, starke Inhalte, eine etablierte Marke und zahlreiche Möglichkeiten, noch mehr Männer zu erreichen und nachhaltig zu wachsen.

In den vergangenen Jahren haben wir unterschiedliche Marketingkanäle aufgebaut, Partnerschaften entwickelt und wertvolle Erfahrungen gesammelt. Jetzt wollen wir diese Aktivitäten noch besser miteinander verbinden, neue Wachstumschancen erschließen und unsere Ideen schneller in die Umsetzung bringen.

Dafür suchen wir dich.

Als Growth & Marketing Manager bist du eine zentrale operative Kraft in unserem Marketing. Du verbindest kreatives Denken mit analytischem Verständnis, entwickelst eigene Ideen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Konzepten konkrete Kampagnen, Tests und Ergebnisse werden.

Diese Rolle ist bewusst breiter als ein klassischer Marketingjob. Du wirst nicht nur einen einzelnen Kanal betreuen, sondern in ganz unterschiedlichen Bereichen mitarbeiten, eigenständig Verantwortung übernehmen und neue Themen vorantreiben.

Du musst dafür nicht alles bereits können. Entscheidend ist, dass du neugierig bist, schnell lernst, lösungsorientiert denkst und Lust hast, Dinge selbst in die Hand zu nehmen.

Wofür Lovebetter steht

Wir lösen sexuelle Probleme wie vorzeitigen Samenerguss oder Erektionsprobleme mit Männern und befähigen sie, ihre innere Stärke, sexuelle Zufriedenheit und Lebensqualität von innen heraus zu transformieren.

Unsere Arbeit wirkt weit über den Einzelnen hinaus: auf Partnerschaften, Familien und kommende Generationen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der unsere Mission mitgestalten möchte, Verantwortung übernimmt und versteht, dass wirkungsvolles Marketing Kreativität, analytisches Denken und konsequente Umsetzung verbindet.

Deine Mission als Growth & Marketing Manager

Du machst Lovebetters Marketing vielseitiger, effizienter und wachstumsstärker.

Du entwickelst Marketingideen, setzt Kampagnen um, betreust bestehende und neue Wachstumskanäle und erkennst anhand von Daten, was funktioniert und wo wir besser werden können.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem CMO, unseren Content-Produzenten, Agenturen und externen Partnern zusammen.

Du übernimmst eigenständig Projekte – von der ersten Idee über die operative Umsetzung bis zur anschließenden Auswertung. Dabei bewegst du dich selbstverständlich zwischen kreativen, analytischen und organisatorischen Aufgaben.

Besonders wichtig: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand für jede Herausforderung eine Lösung vorgibt. Du recherchierst, probierst aus, eignest dir neue Fähigkeiten an und findest Wege, Dinge umzusetzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Marketingkampagnen entwickeln und umsetzen: Du planst und realisierst kanalübergreifende Marketingmaßnahmen, entwickelst kreative Ansätze und begleitest Kampagnen von der Idee bis zur Erfolgsauswertung.
  • Neue Wachstumskanäle erschließen: Du identifizierst neue Möglichkeiten, unsere Zielgruppe zu erreichen, recherchierst Potenziale, entwickelst erste Tests und hilfst dabei, erfolgreiche Ansätze systematisch auszubauen.
  • Ambassador Marketing und Kooperationen vorantreiben: Du entwickelst unser Ambassador-Programm weiter, recherchierst und gewinnst passende Partner, betreust Kooperationen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Beziehungen messbare Marketingmaßnahmen entstehen.
  • Content und Creatives mitgestalten: Du entwickelst Themen, Hooks, Texte und Kampagnenideen, erstellst Briefings und arbeitest mit unseren Content-Produzenten an Inhalten für unterschiedliche Plattformen und Marketingkanäle.
  • CRM und E-Mail-Marketing betreuen: Du setzt Newsletter und Kampagnen um, entwickelst Segmentierungs- und Reaktivierungsansätze und unterstützt dabei, bestehende Kontakte gezielter anzusprechen.
  • Marketingperformance analysieren und optimieren: Du behältst relevante KPIs im Blick, analysierst Kampagnen, Content und Funnels, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen daraus ab.
  • Websites und Landingpages weiterentwickeln: Du übernimmst kleinere Anpassungen an unseren digitalen Angeboten und unterstützt bei Tests und Optimierungen. Wenn du dafür ein neues Tool wie WordPress lernen musst, arbeitest du dich eigenständig ein.
  • Marketingprojekte und Partner koordinieren: Du hältst laufende Projekte zusammen, koordinierst interne und externe Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass Aufgaben zuverlässig und termingerecht umgesetzt werden.
  • KI und Automatisierung sinnvoll einsetzen: Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools für Recherche, Content, Analysen und operative Aufgaben und entwickelst Ideen, wie wir unsere Marketingprozesse kontinuierlich verbessern können.

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Abwechslung statt Silodenken: Du arbeitest nicht ausschließlich an Content, Performance oder Analytics, sondern lernst unterschiedliche Marketingdisziplinen kennen und verbindest sie miteinander.
  • Eigenverantwortung statt langer Abstimmungswege: Du bekommst Raum, eigene Ideen einzubringen, Entscheidungen vorzubereiten und Projekte selbstständig voranzutreiben.
  • Kreativität trifft Zahlen: Du kannst neue Kampagnenideen entwickeln und anschließend anhand konkreter Ergebnisse nachvollziehen, ob sie erfolgreich waren.
  • Lernen gehört zum Job: Du musst nicht jedes Tool und jeden Marketingkanal bereits kennen. Wir schätzen Menschen, die sich Herausforderungen stellen und neue Fähigkeiten selbstständig aufbauen.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem CMO: Du erhältst Einblicke in strategische Marketingentscheidungen und bist eng an der Weiterentwicklung unseres Marketings beteiligt.
  • Persönliche Entwicklung und Perspektive: Du wächst mit deinen Aufgaben und hast die Möglichkeit, mit der Weiterentwicklung von Lovebetter zunehmend Verantwortung für größere Projekte, Prozesse und perspektivisch auch Menschen zu übernehmen.

Dein Impact

Wenn du deinen Job exzellent machst, entsteht:

  • ein Marketing, in dem gute Ideen schneller in konkrete Maßnahmen umgesetzt werden
  • ein Ambassador- und Kooperationsprogramm, das kontinuierlich wächst und messbare Ergebnisse liefert
  • neue Marketingkanäle, die strukturiert getestet, bewertet und weiterentwickelt werden
  • bessere Kampagnen und Inhalte durch die Verbindung von Kreativität und datenbasierten Erkenntnissen
  • optimierte Funnels, CRM-Kampagnen und digitale Kontaktpunkte, die mehr qualifizierte Leads erzeugen
  • effizientere Prozesse durch Eigeninitiative, Automatisierung und den sinnvollen Einsatz von KI
  • ein Marketing-Team, das schneller, selbstständiger und wirkungsvoller arbeitet

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen.

Schick uns keine Standardbewerbung.

Erzähl uns lieber:

  • welche Marketingprojekte oder Kampagnen du bereits eigenständig umgesetzt hast
  • wann du dich zuletzt in ein völlig neues Thema oder Tool eingearbeitet hast und was daraus entstanden ist
  • wie du kreative Ideen entwickelst und herausfindest, ob sie tatsächlich funktionieren
  • welche Aufgaben du schon übernommen hast, obwohl du sie vorher noch nie gemacht hattest
  • und warum du glaubst, dass genau du Lovebetters Marketing mit Kreativität, Eigeninitiative und Umsetzungskraft auf das nächste Level bringen kannst

Stellenanforderungen

Wen wir suchen (und wen nicht)

Diese Rolle passt zu dir, wenn …

  • du bereits praktische Erfahrung im digitalen Marketing gesammelt und idealerweise Kampagnen oder Projekte eigenständig umgesetzt hast
  • du sowohl kreativ als auch analytisch denkst und Spaß daran hast, zwischen unterschiedlichen Aufgaben zu wechseln
  • du eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mitbringst und lieber ins Machen kommst, als lange über Möglichkeiten zu diskutieren
  • du neugierig bist, schnell lernst und dir neue Tools, Plattformen oder Fähigkeiten eigenständig aneignen kannst
  • du auch vor unbekannten Herausforderungen nicht zurückschreckst und den Mut hast, Neues auszuprobieren
  • du Marketingkennzahlen verstehst und aus Ergebnissen sinnvolle Schlussfolgerungen ziehen kannst
  • du strukturiert und zuverlässig arbeitest, Prioritäten setzen kannst und auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick behältst
  • du KI bereits aktiv nutzt oder motiviert bist, sie schnell und sinnvoll in deinen Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren
  • du sehr gut auf Deutsch kommunizierst und ein Gespür für überzeugende Texte und zielgruppengerechte Ansprache hast
  • du Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und Lust hast, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn …

  • du ausschließlich in einer einzelnen Marketingdisziplin arbeiten möchtest und wenig Interesse an anderen Bereichen hast
  • du für neue Aufgaben immer eine detaillierte Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung brauchst
  • du lieber Konzepte entwickelst, als sie selbst umzusetzen
  • du bei unbekannten Tools oder Herausforderungen schnell aufgibst, statt nach Lösungen zu suchen

  • du mit sensiblen Themen wie Sexualität, Männlichkeit, Beziehungen und persönlicher Entwicklung nicht offen und reflektiert umgehen kannst

title: (Senior) Lab Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

At 1KOMMA5°, we connect and manage distributed energy devices at scale. As a Lab Engineer, you will build and configure test setups with integrated PV systems, batteries, heat pumps, and EV chargers. Alongside maintaining and calibrating test equipment, you will develop testing procedures for OEM component compatibility within the Heartbeat platform. Your role also involves providing 3rd-level support, documenting procedures and results, offering guidance to lower-level support teams, and contributing to the improvement of testing methodologies at our Berlin lab.

Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Planning and execution of development-related tests with hardware for an integrated energy control platform
  • OEM and feature integrations: technical exploration with cross-functional teams; coordination and execution of system integration testing
  • Release testing: test conception, coordination, and execution
  • Design and construction of test benches; assemble and configure setups that simulate single-home environments (PV, battery, heat pump, EV charger)
  • Definition of test KPIs, documentation and evaluation of results
  • Develop and improve lab testing software, test automation, methodologies, and procedures
  • Guide junior lab engineers in daily tasks and support their technical and professional development through mentoring

Dein Profil

The successful candidate will have:

  • Completed studies in electrical engineering or mechatronics, 4+ years of experience in assembly, testing, or maintenance of electrical systems, preferably in renewable energy
  • Elektrofachkraft (EFK) qualification and proficiency reading electrical schematics and technical documentation
  • Hands-on experience with multimeters, oscilloscopes, and power analyzers
  • Experience collaborating with development, support teams and stakeholders to troubleshoot technical issues
  • Valid driver’s license Class B
  • Strong documentation skills, with the ability to record and communicate test procedures, results, and best practices
  • Fluency in English and German, both written and verbal

Bonus points for:

  • Familiar with state of the art AI development using Tools like Claude Code, Cursor and other development tools

We are an ambitious and dynamic company with a talented team. We require our engineers to be imaginative, enthusiastic, and willing to tackle new challenges as we strive to provide everyone with renewable energy technologies.

Benefits

  • You are part of a dynamic team with people who prove every day that they can make things happen and move companies forward with great positive impact
  • You move in flat hierarchies and have short decision-making paths. You can learn a lot quickly and get involved at different levels
  • You will be welcomed by a friendly and familiar team
  • You are part of the energy transition and recognize in your daily work what purpose it serves
  • You can work in one of our offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • You create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

title: Principal Engineer - Quality Assurance
description:
YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND

The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want.

Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one.That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Principal Engineer QA as a senior individual contributor. You will define how quality risk is assessed, measured, and gated across the full streaming path - and embed that craft into engineering teams, who own day-to-day tests and suite health.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Quality strategy & risk - Build and maintain a living risk model for the streaming chain. Raise effort where failure hurts most. Make coverage vs. speed and pre-release vs. production trade-offs explicit with product and eng.
  • Release constraints & quality gates - Define what “releasable” means for backend, middleware, and clients - including how continuous backend/middleware delivery is gated relative to client store cadences (web/TV/mobile). Keep gates fast, trustworthy, and hard to bypass.
  • Rollout practice (build with the teams) - Define and establish staged rollout, canary, and rollback strategies together with eng and SRE/ops. Own the definition; establish and operate them collaboratively.
  • Test architecture - Set the pyramid and ownership boundaries (unit through E2E, performance, playback/stream validation) so each layer has a clear home inside eng. Drive cross-stack design that exercises real policy and format decisions.
  • Incident & reliability partnership - Join major quality incidents with a quality lens; strengthen production feedback for streaming health; turn escapes into durable tests, monitors, gate changes, and rollout improvements.
  • Tooling & automation standards - Set practical standards for frameworks, CI integration, test data, environments, and reporting so teams share patterns with clear ownership and measurable ROI.
  • AI-enabled quality engineering - Define where AI raises quality leverage: test generation and maintenance, risk-based test selection, failure triage, and incident analysis. Set standards for AI-assisted testing and shape quality expectations for AI-authored code as delivery speed and change volume increase.
  • Mentoring & influence - Embed quality craft into eng: risk-based testing, quality in PRs, middleware policy and multi-platform client testing. Socialize lightweight, strong-default standards (definition of done, flake policy, critical-path coverage). Influence design reviews when quality risk is material.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

  • Org-wide quality strategy, risk model, and whole-stack standards
  • Release constraints and quality gates; definition of “releasable”
  • Definition of staged rollout/canary/rollback strategies (to be established with partners)
  • Test architecture principles and automation norms
  • Cross-stack escape analysis and quality debt for gates and tooling
  • Embedding quality craft in engineering; influencing high-risk designs
  • Standards for AI-assisted testing and quality expectations for AI-authored code

WHO YOU’LL PARTNER WITH

  • Engineering - They implement and own tests/suites in services and clients; you set architecture, gates, and standards, and build quality practice into delivery.
  • Product - Journey and tenant/feature priority; acceptance of residual risk within the gates you define.
  • SRE / Ops - Establish and operate rollout strategies together; production signals, incident response, capacity/reliability.
  • Platform/tooling - CI, environments, shared frameworks, observability for quality signals.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • Track record as a senior IC in quality engineering (or equivalent) for complex, multi-service products - ideally streaming, media, or similarly high-availability consumer platforms
  • Experience designing whole-stack quality strategy: backend services, configuration/policy layers, and multi-platform clients
  • Ability to define and land test architecture (pyramid, ownership, cross-stack integration/contract/playback-style validation) that engineering teams can run and own
  • Strong influence without authority: you raise the bar inside eng teams, socialize standards, and hold the line on gates without managing a QA org
  • Strong software engineering skills at senior level or above; you write production-quality code, not just test scripts
  • Designing and coding for testability, and building automation as a first-class engineering product
  • Deep familiarity with CI/CD, with a track record of making pipelines faster and more reliable
  • Hands-on experience applying AI to quality engineering, with judgment on where it reduces risk and where it adds noise
  • Comfort partnering on incidents and turning production failure modes into durable quality improvements
  • Practical judgment on automation: enough to protect risk, not so much that brittle suites block the org
  • Bonus:
    • Hands-on engineering background with video ingest, encoding/packaging, playback, or multi-tenant config/policy surfaces
    • Work across web, TV, and mobile client quality risk (device/OS/store constraints)

WHY JOIN US?

At Zattoo, you’re always on firm ground with real freedom to explore. You’ll have the support and opportunity you need to go far, while you’re helping us create a sustainable and entertainment-filled future for all.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

  • Reward: strong market competitive salary
  • Recharge: 30 days vacation plus public holidays
  • Regulate:trust based flexible working hours and the option for remote work worldwide for up to 8 weeks per year

Plus:

  • We’re sharing: Free access to the best streaming experience on the market
  • We're developing: Your own development budget, German classes and Zattoo all-company hack days
  • We’re inclusive: ‘Zattooies’ are a fun, engaged, and diverse team made up of 47 nationalities
  • We’re healthy: Health checks, mental wellbeing support, team sports and more!
  • We’re responsible: We are carbon neutral, an active employee Green team, discounted BVG tickets and free bike rentals
  • We’re sociable: A calendar of events with fireside chats, lunches, in-house bar, BBQ’s, monthly socials, summer party and an annual off-site event

Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. Regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law we encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunities employer — join us and help build a diverse team dedicated to revolutionising the way you watch TV.

We are committed to ensuring fair, open, and equitable hiring practices and are happy to answer any questions you may have about us or the role throughout the whole process. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we share the applicable compensation range with you before your first interview.

This role is located in Germany and requires full physical presence within the country. Dein Profil

• Backend Engineering: Strong senior experience in building and maintaining complex systems using Ruby on Rails.

• API Design: Proven expertise in designing clean APIs, data models, and managing background job processing.

• System Architecture: Sound understanding of authorization concepts, billing workflows, and automated testing strategies.

• LLM Practice: Practical experience building LLM applications, evaluations, and agent workflows.

• End-to-End Ownership: Ability and mindset to own functionality independently from initial design to live production.

• Technical Communication: Strong communication skills to collaborate with product and domain experts and make technical trade-offs explicit.

Warum Caspar Health?

  • Remote-first with flexible working hours – office optional in Berlin-Mitte or up to 90 days a year outside of Germany
  • To match this, we support you with a monthly home office allowance and an additional meal subsidy
  • Plenty of time to recharge – with 30 vacation days per year

  • Genuine collaboration – no silos, no egos. After all, we’re all working toward the same vision. #ValueFocus!
  • Access to all Caspar offerings for mental and physical well-being #HealthyTogether!
  • And yes – all the snacks your heart desires, group sports sessions, a never-empty drinks fridge, and a healthy dose of humor are included too

What defines us as a team

  • We live diversity – it's not a marketing slogan, it's part of our everyday reality

title: Tech Lead AI Engineering (m/w/d)
description:
For a young company in the rapidly growing AI implementation market, we are looking for a Tech Lead, starting as soon as possible, ideally in early November. The company runs LLM-based systems in production: content generation pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on internal documents, and automated workflows closely integrated with their business systems. The entire stack is built on TypeScript and Next.js.

These systems are already live. As Tech Lead, you take ownership of them, increase their reliability and quality, and expand them to new use cases, while being technically responsible for a team. The role brings together applied LLM engineering and solid backend engineering in TypeScript. Training or fine-tuning foundation models is not part of the job.

Stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Postgres with pgvector, Docker, Azure, Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, Vercel AI SDK.

What you’ll do

  • Technical responsibility for the team, including architecture decisions and code reviews

  • Technical guidance for the team and point of contact for non-technical colleagues

  • Take over and maintain the existing LLM pipelines: review the current architecture, identify failure modes, prioritise fixes, and refactor and extend the systems without disrupting production

  • Own the RAG systems from end to end: document ingestion and parsing, chunking, indexing, hybrid retrieval (BM25 and vector), query rewriting, reranking and grounded generation with citations

  • Implement and maintain chunk-level access control, index freshness and tenant isolation across all retrieval systems

  • Develop content generation pipelines that deliver consistent quality at scale, including human review steps

  • Build and run automated workflows against internal and third-party business systems (ERP, CRM, email, internal APIs), with durable and idempotent execution, retry and dead-letter handling, and approval steps for irreversible actions

  • Set up an evaluation framework for systems that currently run without one: golden datasets based on real production failures, retrieval metrics and more

  • Implement observability along the entire request path

  • Optimise cost and latency through prompt caching, batching, model routing and smaller models where it makes sense

  • Identify where deterministic logic is the better choice and implement it accordingly

  • Work directly with non-technical colleagues to define and validate automated processes

What you bring

  • Professional experience with at least one LLM-based system in production, including responsibility for its operation and incident handling

  • Advanced TypeScript and Node.js skills: strict typing of non-deterministic model output, async and concurrency patterns, streaming responses, structured error handling

  • Production experience with Next.js: App Router, route handlers, server actions, streaming to the client

  • Proven track record of taking over and improving existing codebases under production traffic

  • Hands-on retrieval expertise: hybrid search, choosing embedding models, cross-encoder reranking, metadata filtering, permission-aware retrieval and structured diagnosis of poor retrieval quality

  • Experience working with real-world documents: PDFs with tables, scanned material, DOCX, HTML, including layout-aware parsing, OCR and evidence-based chunking

  • Structured outputs and tool calling are part of your daily work: JSON Schema, Zod or similar runtime validation, function calling, handling malformed or partial output, context window management

  • Experience designing and running LLM evaluations

  • Experience with LLM tracing and evaluation tools in a TypeScript codebase (e.g. Braintrust, Langfuse, Promptfoo, OpenTelemetry or Arize Phoenix)

  • Familiarity with Postgres including vector search (pgvector or a comparable vector store), Docker, Git, CI/CD and at least one major cloud platform

  • Practical experience with the Anthropic and/or OpenAI TypeScript SDKs

  • Confident communication in English, German is a plus

Nice to have

  • Durable workflow execution for long-running, unattended processes (Temporal, Inngest or similar)

  • Agent orchestration in production, tool calling, recovery, multi-step workflows (Vercel AI SDK, LangGraph, Mastra, Claude Agent SDK, MCP TypeScript SDK)

  • Experience integrating enterprise systems such as ERP or CRM platforms like SAP

  • Security and data protection in LLM systems, defences against prompt injection and data exfiltration, PII handling, GDPR-compliant design, EU-hosted or self-hosted inference

  • Structured or graph-based retrieval for entity-heavy dataexperience

  • Migrating live pipelines to a new model, embedding model or index without loss of quality

  • Azure DevOps, Pipelines, Repos and Boards

Benefits

  • Hybrid setup with 2 office days per week in a bright office in Cologne’s Belgian Quarter (with two balconies and the best view of the city ;))

  • Continuous professional, strategic and technological development

  • An open feedback culture, transparent communication and short decision-making paths

  • Regular team events and workations

  • Salary from €60,000 gross per year, with room for more depending on experience

description:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

 

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

 

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

 

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

 

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY.

title: Market Product Lead
description:
About Us

Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.

In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.

You will own the peptide and protein platform as a commercial product: the market analysis behind it, the target product profiles it is judged against, the decisions about what we build and license first, the go to market strategy and the positioning that partners hear. Market and competitive intelligence

  • Build and maintain a rigorous view of the peptide/protein therapeutics landscape by segment, indication and modality, mechanism trends and delivery technologies.

  • Decide, on evidence, which platform capabilities become licensable products and in what sequence, balancing near-term revenue against durable differentiation.

  • Define packaging and commercial models for each offering, including access arrangements, bespoke model fine-tuning on partner data, co-development structures and asset-level licensing.

title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
description:
Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading.

About the Role

We're hiring a Special Projects Lead to take Fleek's new category bets from thesis to proven economics. Each is a new business line that could add £5M+ in GMV, opening a new supply category or a new sourcing geography for the marketplace. Here's what makes these bets unusually winnable. Fleek already owns the demand. Most of the live bets sell to buyers who transact on Fleek today, so they're a supply-first test rather than a two-sided cold start. Your job on a new bet is to find and onboard the supply, sell it into demand that already exists and read the economics fast.

Every bet runs through the same gates. If a bet misses its gates, you kill it with evidence and move to the next one. If it works and you're running it well, you don't have to hand it off. You scale into owning the category, with supply, acquisition and ops building out under you. Think of this seat as a venture builder inside Fleek.

One thing this is not. We're not building a sales team or a sales culture, and this is not an AE or account manager role with a new title. You'll work directly with the founders and our commercial lead, close to the centre of the company.

What You'll Do

  • Run bets through the gates: take each bet from market research to first suppliers to first GMV to a feasible-or-not call, with win metrics and kill metrics defined before you start.

  • Go where the supply is: get on planes. You'll visit suppliers, graders and rag houses in the markets your bets open up, because this trade is built face to face and the best stock never gets listed anywhere.

  • Sell supply into live demand: onboard brands, brokers, graders and wholesalers, then get Fleek's existing buyers transacting on the new inventory. The sell is fast, informal and relationship-led, over WhatsApp and Instagram as often as in a boardroom.

  • Make the kill calls: hold a clear view of unit economics and the competitive landscape on every bet. Double down or cut on evidence, not attachment.

  • Be the ops function, for now: work out importer-of-record structures, duties, freight cost and last mile for each new flow.

  • Ride the AI infrastructure: our acquisition team has spent months building the agentic outreach and enrichment engine. You'll plug your bets into it and extend it, rather than building from a blank page or adding headcount.

  • Learn the actual trade: how stock is graded, routed and priced across markets, and who's sitting on good inventory that nobody has approached. You'll get deep in it fast.

What You Bring

  • Zero-to-one is your natural habitat. You've built something from nothing as a founder, an early employee or the person who started a new line inside an existing company. You've operated without a playbook and you didn't wait for one.

  • Operator and commercial in one person. You build the machine and you carry the number. You're not pure strategy and you're not pure sales, and you're comfortable being measured on GMV within your first quarter.

  • AI fluency. You work with agents and automations daily and you'd rather build a workflow than repeat a task.

Strong signals on top of that:

  • An instinct for physical goods. You understand inventory, margins and trading relationships, or you've worked around fashion, resale or marketplaces.

  • Deals you structured yourself, at any size, that didn't exist before you wrote them.

  • Exposure to cross-border trade, logistics or supply chain operations.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience in resale, surplus or secondary-market inventory

  • Experience launching a new market, geography or product line from scratch

  • Established networks in international sourcing markets

What You'll Get

  • Generous equity: being on Fleek means you'll own a part of it

Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade: a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

title: Talent Director
description:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

 

The Role

The Talent Director owns how OLIX finds, wins and hires the people who will build it. You will take a talent function built for around 200 people and make it one that carries us confidently to 1,000, across London, Bristol, Austin, San Francisco and Toronto, without lowering the bar on a single hire.

This is a hands on leadership role. You will personally lead our most senior and executive searches, and close people who are not looking. Many of the people we need exist in pools of a few dozen worldwide: III-V device engineers, advanced packaging architects, optical interconnect specialists, AI software engineers, silicon leaders who have taken a chip to production. Hiring them is a precision problem, not a volume one. You will build a team of recruiters as sharp as the engineers they hire, and set an AI strategy for recruiting that changes how we decide, not just how fast we work. The best argument wins here, and we expect you to make it, welcome challenges to it, and change your mind when the evidence says so.

 

Responsibilities

  • Build and scale the talent function from around 200 to 1,000 people: org design, hiring, priorities and operating rhythm, in place before the headcount arrives

  • Lead senior and executive searches directly, including the hires that signal the calibre of people joining OLIX

  • Attract, hire and develop top Recruiters and Sourcers, and hold them to the same bar as our engineers

  • Own the hiring bar: what great looks like for each role family, and how consistently every interviewer applies it

  • Build the playbook for extremely scarce talent: mapping the market, building relationships early, and closing passive candidates

  • Set OLIX's AI strategy for recruiting, deciding where AI improves our judgement and where people need to stay in the loop

  • Own hiring systems, data and metrics, and partner with the exec team on workforce planning, including saying when a plan is not hireable as written

  • Build OLIX's talent brand so the best people in photonics, silicon and AI know who we are

 

Skills & Experience

  • Has built and led a talent function through hyper-growth, from a few hundred people toward 1,000 or beyond, while keeping quality high. This is non-negotiable

  • Either versed in deep tech already, or curious enough to go deep on product and technology and hold your own with engineers

  • Direct experience hiring in photonics, optoelectronics, advanced packaging, silicon or AI software

  • Experience hiring across the UK and US and running a multi-site function

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location
