title: Senior Acquisition Marketeer
description:
The Challenge

Talk360 connects more than 6 million people across 190 countries. How they find us is changing fast: Search is moving from blue links to AI generated answers and paid and organic increasingly shape each other. A missed opportunity here isn't just a lower ROAS number. It's someone staying connected with family abroad, a business trying to reach a supplier, or someone who urgently needs to reach a real phone number.

As our Senior Acquisition Marketeer, you won't own a channel. You'll own the outcome: Figuring out where Talk360's next valuable user is and the smartest way to reach them, across Google, Meta, TikTok, SEO, app stores, AI search, and whatever comes next. Think investment manager for acquisition, not channel specialist.

Talk360 has been profitably growing since 2025. We're a lean team of around 30 people, with the majority of team working from the Amsterdam office. We're looking for someone genuinely channel agnostic: you don't wake up thinking about Google Ads or SEO; you wake up thinking about where the next valuable Talk360 user is.

What you’ll do

Your role owns the step that matters most: translating a business question into a clear definition, a well-designed model, and conversational/agentic analytics that your leadership trusts. You will set the analytical architecture, dbt standards, and roadmap, while Vahid focuses on ingestion, warehouse reliability, and engineering implementation. Within twelve months, two or three priority business domains are governed end to end, leadership can trace performance from acquisition through lifetime value using consistent numbers, self-service adoption is growing, and Vahid can independently implement the modeling patterns and quality standards you established.

With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role.


Role and Responsibilities

As our Senior Sales Operations Manager, your job is to make it easier for Sales to do great work. This is a hands-on role with a broad view of the commercial journey. You’ll work on how Sales operates, support leadership with better insight, and own processes such as the Deal Desk, vendor registration, invoicing, collections, and order-to-cash.

We see those responsibilities as connected. Being close to the day-to-day work gives you the context to see where time is being lost, where a process no longer works, and where the same problem keeps coming back. We want someone who is comfortable doing the work themselves, but who does not simply accept unnecessary manual work because “that’s how we do it.”

This role is a combination of keeping things moving today and making sure they work better tomorrow.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Improving how Sales works. You use data, feedback, and your understanding of the day-to-day work to identify where things can be better. That could mean redesigning a workflow, improving reporting, clarifying ownership, creating a better operating rhythm, or removing manual steps that no longer add value.

  • Helping Sales leadership improve performance. You look beyond individual requests and help spot patterns across the Sales organization. Where are deals slowing down? What does the data tell us about why? Are we missing information in HubSpot that would help Sales, Marketing, or leadership make better decisions? You turn those observations into practical recommendations and are comfortable challenging existing ways of working when the data points somewhere else.

  • Owning and improving the Deal Desk. When a deal needs something outside the standard process, you help move it forward. This can include approvals, documentation, commercial questions, vendor or supplier registration, procurement portals, questionnaires, and coordination across internal and external stakeholders. You take care of the immediate need, while also looking for patterns that could make the next request simpler.

  • Owning order-to-cash and collections. You take responsibility for turning booked revenue into collected cash. Collections is a meaningful and hands-on part of the role: monitoring outstanding invoices, following up with customers, picking up the phone when that is the best way to resolve an issue, and working with Sales, Finance, procurement teams, and other stakeholders to clear payment blockers. You also look at the process behind the work — reducing overdue balances, improving follow-up, and finding ways to make order-to-cash more effective over time.

  • Working AI-first. You actively use AI and automation where they can make the work more efficient or improve the quality of the outcome. That might mean analyzing patterns in Sales data, speeding up vendor registration, improving a recurring workflow, or removing repetitive administrative work. As part of RevOps, you are expected to try new approaches, keep what works, and share useful ways of working with the wider team.

  • Connecting the dots across teams. Many commercial processes cross Sales, Finance, Customer Experience, Marketing, Operations, and other parts of the business. You help create clarity around ownership, bring the right people together, and make sure decisions turn into action.

You’ll work with tools including HubSpot, Gong, Atlassian, QuotaPath, Zapier, Google Workspace, and a growing set of AI tools and internal AI workflows. We do not expect you to arrive as an expert in every system. We do expect you to be comfortable learning how they fit together and questioning whether we are using them in the best way.

Success in this role is not simply an empty queue or a dashboard that looks good. It is reliable day-to-day execution combined with steady improvement in how Sales operates.

 

On a typical day

On Monday morning, you start by getting a view of the commercial week ahead. You check active deals in HubSpot, outstanding operational requests, the payments inbox, and anything else that needs attention.

During the RevOps stand-up with the RevOps team, you talk through priorities. An Account Executive is working on an enterprise opportunity where the customer's procurement team needs AIHR registered as a vendor. Several invoices need follow-up. You have also noticed a group of deals spending longer than expected in one stage of the pipeline.

The vendor registration comes first. You use one of our existing AI workflows to help complete the documentation, gather any missing information internally, and get the process moving. While doing that, you notice that part of the information the workflow relies on is out of date. Rather than working around it, you fix the source and make sure the next registration is easier.

Later, you turn to the stalled opportunities. You dig into the data, speak with the Sales team, and find that Account Executives are not consistently recording meeting outcomes. That makes it difficult to understand why certain MQLs progress while others do not.

The answer may not be “Sales needs to update HubSpot more.” You look at why the information is not being captured in the first place and whether the workflow can be made easier for reps while still giving Marketing and leadership the information they need. You believe it’s easier to change a process than to change human behaviors.

After lunch with colleagues in the office, you spend time on collections. Some invoices need a straightforward reminder. Others need more persistence. You follow up with customers, get on the phone where needed, and work through issues involving purchase orders, invoicing details, procurement processes, or internal ownership.

This work is part of the role, not something sitting outside it. And because you are doing it yourself, you see first-hand which issues are one-offs and which ones point to something we should fix.

On another day, you sit down with Sales leadership to look at commercial performance. You are not there simply to report what happened. You help interpret what is behind the numbers and what we might do differently.

You also regularly connect with Neal, Head of CX & Operations, and colleagues across Business Operations. Some weeks you will spend more time on live operational work; other weeks give you more room to improve reporting, build an automation in Zapier, clean up a process in HubSpot, or work on a broader RevOps project.

That balance is part of the role.

By Friday, a good week means the work got done: customers were followed up, deals moved forward, Sales had the support they needed, and something in the way we operate is now a little clearer or easier than it was before.

Both work, and both have far more potential than we currently capture. This is a quota-carrying role with a build mandate. You manage a running book of business with our existing commercial partners and stay their main point of contact. You will regularly present proposals and results to AIHR leadership.

On a typical day

On a typical Monday morning, you start with your pipeline. Your existing partner book is quick to review: a few conversations need a nudge, two QBRs are coming up. The larger partnerships take more thought. Other companies in our industry have built significant revenue through resellers, consultancies, and universities, but these deals have a longer sales cycle, so you always keep several opportunities moving at the same time. Today that means a value-added reseller in the middle of a negotiation, a prospective university that wants to add AIHR’s courses to its 2027 academic year, and a consultancy that signed last month and now needs to get moving.

After lunch you speak with the managing partner of a German niche consultancy that does a lot of HR implementation work. Her clients keep running into the same problem: the new system goes live, and the HR team lacks the skills to get the most out of it. You talk through how capability building could become part of her offering, with AIHR as the partner behind it. She is interested, and you agree to work out a commercial proposal together. Next you work on an enablement session for consultants, covering what they need to know about our courses, how they bring AIHR into a client conversation, what a first joint win could look like, and you brief Marketing on the materials their consultants will need.

The next morning is for outreach. You build a sourcing list of potential partners in a segment you want to open up, and you contact them yourself. AIHR has a very good name in the HR industry, and that usually helps open doors. Later that week you run a QBR with one of your strongest commercial partners. You review their numbers together, agree on two concrete actions, and set a date to check back in. You identify where there is room to grow the relationship and push for more where performance has stalled. You also notice that a large part of their customer base works in corporate HR teams, so you bring in a colleague from Sales to explore a B2B opportunity through the same relationship.

On Thursday you are back with the value-added reseller. They want to bundle our courses with their own services. It is a model we haven’t proven yet. You treat it as a pilot and agree on a first version you can learn from. Some of these experiments will not work out. The ones that do become the programs you build the channel on, and you will be the person who figured them out.

You close out the week updating your forecast and walking your manager through where the existing book, pipeline, and new programs stand. Friday afternoon wraps with a quick team catch-up and, if you're in the Rotterdam office, our regular Friday drinks.

title: Growth Account Executive / Account Manager
description:
Are you energized by growing existing business, building relationships, and finding hidden opportunities in a large portfolio? Do you enjoy combining structure and process with commercial instincts, and using AI to work smarter? At AIHR, we’re looking for a Growth Account Executive / Account Manager to take ownership of a global client base and help us expand our footprint with the world’s leading companies.

About AIHR

Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals.

We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players.

Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role.

Role and Responsibilities

As a Growth Account Executive / Account Manager, you are tasked with retaining and growing existing clients. That includes conducting meetings, demos, negotiations, and value-building. You will work on a portfolio which includes approximately ±175 clients primarily in the Mid-Market segment (1,000 to 5,000 employees), who spend on average around 8.5k € ARR with us, though actual deal sizes vary, with some larger accounts (25k € +) included. This portfolio includes some well-known brands, as well as more locally known organizations. These clients are based around the world in different industries. What these clients have in common is that they are all developing their HR teams with us.

You are tasked with evangelizing our latest product offerings and services, including our AI programs that help HR teams build AI skills. And by doing so, you will drive your pipeline growth. With 175 accounts, you can't give every client the same amount of time. That's why you use AI tools to research accounts, prepare for meetings, and spot expansion signals across your portfolio, so more of your time goes to conversations with clients. In this role you will be working together closely with our Learning Consulting (Customer Success) team.

About our Market

Reports state that the global e-learning market was worth USD 215 billion in 2021. Moreover, it is estimated to reach an expected value of USD 645 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 13% during the forecast period (2022–2030). We’ve grown from €0 to €10M in revenue in 6 years, bootstrapped. And 80% of our sales team hit their targets. AIHR is currently trailblazing the path in HR-specific e-learning. You can be a part of that.

On a typical day

You arrive at our 20th-floor HQ in Rotterdam, just across from Central Station, in the morning. After a brief chat with your colleagues, you grab a cup of coffee, start your computer, check your calendar for any last-minute changes, and prepare the day around the calls you have planned with your customers, and internal meetings with colleagues. For each client call, you ask your custom GPT for a quick account brief based on HubSpot/Gong data, platform usage, and notes from past calls.

Then, you review a report that Silvia from the product team has shared with you. A few weeks ago, you got the idea that clients who download resources to assess their AI-maturity and who have larger HR teams might be interested in our new AI Boot Camp offering. You used AI to cross-reference those downloads with HR team size in HubSpot and build a target list. You outlined this hypothesis in a short business case you pitched to Emilie, your manager, who agreed. We’ve been running a campaign on this topic with our marketing team. Now some clients want to talk! You discuss the campaign results with your peers Jessica, Max and Filip.

Rik, our in-house chef, serves lunch, and you enjoy it with the wider sales team. Next, you have a few 30-minute client meetings in a row, followed by admin. You open HubSpot (our CRM) and go through your daily tasks. Next, you work on a proposal for a client you spoke with the day before. You use AI to draft a first version tailored to the goals they shared on the call, then sharpen it yourself. You also prepare another client presentation.

You use our tool Gong to review parts of the call you had earlier because you applied some tactics you learned in training on SPICED last month. Gong's AI summary points you straight to the moments that matter. You share relevant parts of the call with Emilie as part of your development plan (everyone at AIHR has one, as hunger to grow is one of our core values). Before you know it, it’s the end of the day.

Luckily, it’s the last Friday of the month, a social gathering! This is when the whole team comes together to celebrate our successes (we have many!), eat something, drink, and get to know each other outside of work.


Who you are

We’re looking for someone positive, resilient, and curious, a true relationship builder with excellent communication skills, and someone who is not afraid to fail.

The ideal candidate has the following:

  • Minimum 3+ years experience in a closing role;

  • Experience with successfully owning at least 1,5 million € portfolio and/or closing 25 k € deals at mid-market companies;

  • Experience renewing and growing clients;

  • Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) for tasks like account research, meeting prep, proposal writing, and workflow automation is essential;

  • The ability to talk credibly with HR leaders about how AI is changing their function;

  • A relentless drive to win, with the courage to hold clients accountable;

  • Commercially assertive - never a pushover, always pushing for the close;

  • A shark’s instinct for the deal: sensing opportunities and going for them without hesitation;

  • Excellent written and verbal English skills;

  • A talent for hypothesis-based thinking;

  • Track record of continuously overachieved targets;

  • An exceptional sense of responsibility;

  • Experience working for a fast-growing organization;

  • A sixth sense for commercial opportunities;

  • Knowledge of WinningByDesign is a plus;

  • Affinity with E-Learning and/or HR is a plus.

We offer

  • A key role in shaping the education of tens of thousands of Human Resource professionals from all over the world through our courses;

  • Benchmarked compensation;

  • The opportunity to shape your day-to-day work;

  • A personal development plan with a structured path toward your next promotion;

  • Flexible working hours & working from home arrangements after your onboarding;

  • A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team;

  • A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company;

  • A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Millennium Tower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam;

  • 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for every year you work here + you can exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice;

  • Pension plan;

  • 5 Mental health days per year;

  • Access to OpenUp mental health platform;

  • Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read!

  • All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card);

  • MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work;

  • Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities;

  • Free access to the office gym.

title: Data Engineer
description:
De wereld om ons heen verandert razendsnel. Wat vandaag nieuw is, kan morgen alweer achterhaald zijn. Bij PuurData krijg je de kans om samen met collega’s te werken aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld bedrijven helpen met het inzichtelijk maken van hun data of meedenken over hoe ze veiliger met hun data om kunnen gaan. Je helpt onze klanten vooruit door ze mee te nemen in nieuwe technologieën en te laten zien waar bijvoorbeeld AI daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt. Op deze manier kun je zowel kleine, maar ook grote en veeleisende bedrijven helpen met oplossingen die kritisch zijn voor hun bedrijfsvoering.  

Tenslotte zorgen wij er samen voor dat jij continu blijft groeien en op de hoogte bent van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen. 

 

Wat ga je doen?  

Als Data Engineer bij PuurData ben je meer dan een technicus. Je bent een consultant die klanten helpt om meer waarde uit hun data te halen. PuurData werkt met platformen zoals Elastic en AWS, en bedient klanten op het gebied van zoektechnologie, observability, security en AI. Jij bent degene die die oplossingen tot leven brengt.

Je start bij de klant. Je inventariseert de vraag: wat willen ze met hun data? Gaat het om betere zoekfunctionaliteit, real-time inzicht in systemen, of security en threat detection? Klanten weten vaak dat er iets niet klopt. Data is traag, er is geen inzicht, of er zijn performance problemen. Maar ze weten niet altijd hoe ze het moeten oplossen. Jij helpt dat helder te maken.

Vervolgens ga je samen met de klant naar de juiste oplossing toe. Je vertaalt de behoefte naar een concrete aanpak en implementeert die van A tot Z: van het inrichten van de datastroom tot het opleveren van dashboards en inzichten.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De use cases lopen uiteen van zoekoplossingen en business process monitoring tot SIEM-implementaties en data engineering-pipelines. Dat geeft je veel vrijheid in de invulling van je werk.

Continu leren is geen optie, maar de norm
Technologie staat niet stil, en jij ook niet. Bij PuurData is training verplicht. Je blijft op de hoogte van de laatste ontwikkelingen, denk aan Elastic, AI-integraties en nieuwe dataplatformen, en past die kennis direct toe in klantprojecten.


Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ondernemende professional die weinig sturing nodig heeft. Je denkt vanuit de eindgebruiker en streeft naar maximale klanttevredenheid zonder kwaliteit en veiligheid uit het oog te verliezen. Dankzij jouw analytisch vermogen zie je snel de kern van een probleem en kom je met creatieve, structurele oplo ssingen. Je kunt technische keuzes helder onderbouwen en klanten daarin meenemen, ook als het complex is. Daarin mag je best een tikkeltje eigenwijs zijn.


Nog geen doorgewinterde expert?

Geen probleem. Als je leergierig bent en en affiniteit hebt met data, komen we graag met je in contact.

Persoonlijke vaardigheden:

  • Analytisch sterk, je ziet snel verbanden in data en datastructuren

  • Leergierig en gedreven om jezelf continu te blijven ontwikkelen

  • Zelfstandig maar samenwerkingsgericht, je pakt door zonder dat iemand je hoeft aan te sturen

  • Communicatief vaardig, je vertaalt technische keuzes naar begrijpelijke taal voor klanten

  • Probleemoplossend, je zoekt structurele oplossingen in plaats van tijdelijke fixes

Professionele vaardigheden:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau in een technische of data-gerelateerde richting

  • 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring in data engineering of een vergelijkbare consultancy rol

  • Ervaring met ETL/ELT processen, data modeling en data pipelines

Pré:

  • Affiniteit met of kennis van Elastic, SQL of vergelijkbare data-platformen

  • Ervaring met data orchestration, data lakes of dashboarding tools

  • Kennis van cloud omgevingen zoals AWS of Azure

  • Begrijpt hoe data-architectuur bijdraagt aan AI-toepassingen en procesautomatisering


Waarom werken bij PuurData?

Je krijgt de vrijheid om je eigen werkweek in te richten en werkt aan uitdagende projecten bij uiteenlopende klanten, geen saaie repeterende klussen. Je werkt in een platte organisatie waar jouw mening telt en er snel geschakeld wordt. Daarnaast bieden we een salaris passend bij jouw ervaring, pensioen zonder eigen bijdrage en volop ruimte om door te groeien.

Herken jij jezelf hierin? We horen graag van je.

Wil je nog aanvullende informatie? Mail dan naar

 S.v.p geen acquisitie, wij werven zelf!

title: Senior Quality Engineer

Als Senior Quality Engineer ben je een sleutelspeler in het naar een hoger volwassenheidsniveau brengen van onze kwaliteitsperformance. Je acteert proactief, signaleert risico’s vóórdat ze problemen worden en stuurt op duurzame oplossingen. Je bent geen volger van processen, maar mede‑vormgever van hoe kwaliteit wordt geborgd, verbeterd en beleefd wordt bij ons.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het inhoudelijk en methodisch leiden van verbetertrajecten, waaronder het aanjagen en begeleiden van het Quality Improvement Team (QIT‑proces). Je fungeert daarbij als coach, challenger en inhoudelijk geweten.

Wat ga je, onder andere, doen?

  • Proactief analyseren van kwaliteitsafwijkingen, trends en risico’s om structurele, systeemgedreven oorzaken bloot te leggen.

Je werkt intensief samen met productie, engineering, supply chain en klanten, maar neemt vooral ook inhoudelijk leiderschap. Je stelt de juiste vragen, doorbreekt reactieve patronen en helpt de organisatie om kwaliteit voorspelbaar, robuust en toekomstbestendig in te richten. description:

title: Senior C++ Firmware Engineer (VNA & Test & Measurement)
description:
At Benchmark, we develop innovative technology solutions that help our customers bring advanced products to market. Our engineers work on complex systems in high-tech environments, contributing to products that require precision, performance, and reliability.

To support the continued development of advanced RF and Test & Measurement solutions, we are looking for a highly skilled Senior C++ Firmware Engineer with expertise in Vector Network Analyzers (VNA), RF measurements, and instrument software development.

This role offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge measurement systems, extending instrument capabilities into the mmWave domain while collaborating with international engineering teams operating at the forefront of high-frequency technology.

The Role

As a Senior C++ Firmware Engineer, you will take technical ownership of software subsystems within advanced Test & Measurement products. You will contribute to the integration of mmWave converter functionality, development of calibration-related features, firmware verification, and enhancement of VNA measurement capabilities up to 170 GHz.

You are comfortable working with large existing software architectures and can effectively analyze, modify, and extend complex instrument software while maintaining product quality and performance.

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong C++ development capabilities with practical understanding of RF measurements, calibration concepts, and automated verification methodologies.

You will also leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, or similar technologies to improve development efficiency while maintaining full engineering ownership of the solution delivered.

Your Responsibilities

  • Take technical ownership of firmware and software subsystems within advanced Test & Measurement products

  • Analyze and extend existing C++ software architectures and instrument software platforms

  • Develop and integrate new functionality for VNA and mmWave measurement systems

  • Implement calibration-related features and measurement workflows

  • Support integration of mmWave converters and high-frequency measurement capabilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain SCPI-controlled instrument functionality

  • Develop and execute automated verification and validation activities

  • Create and maintain Python-based test automation frameworks

  • Perform debugging, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and performance optimization

  • Ensure software quality through unit, integration, and system testing

  • Collaborate with system architects, firmware engineers, hardware engineers, and customer-facing technical teams

  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, and integration challenges at an early stage

  • Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and engineering best practices

  • Apply AI-assisted development tools responsibly to improve productivity, code quality, testing, and documentation


What You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field

  • Strong professional experience with modern C++ software development

  • Experience working with large-scale instrument software or firmware codebases

  • Experience with C++ templates, generic programming, and modern software design principles

  • Experience with Qt application development

  • Experience with firmware development, hardware communication, and device control

  • Advanced knowledge of multithreading and concurrent software architectures

  • Experience with Visual Studio and CMake-based development environments

  • Strong understanding of SCPI protocols and instrument control

  • Experience with Python-based automated testing and verification

  • Experience with unit, integration, and system-level testing

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, or similar technologies

  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical problem-solving skills

  • Ability to independently execute work packages and take technical ownership

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Experience collaborating within distributed or international engineering teams using Git

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Vector Network Analyzers (VNA)

  • RF measurement and calibration expertise

  • Knowledge of S-parameter measurements, leveling, and ALC concepts

  • Experience within the Test & Measurement industry

  • Experience with mmWave converters and high-frequency measurement systems

  • Familiarity with Spectrum Analyzer or Signal Generator products

  • Experience with automated test frameworks such as PyTest

  • Experience working within remote or customer-hosted development environments

  • Experience interacting directly with technical customer stakeholders

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of high-frequency RF systems above 110 GHz

  • Digital Design Test (DDT) experience

  • On-wafer measurement experience

  • Familiarity with measurement simulation environments

  • Experience with Jira and Confluence

  • Dutch communication skills are desirable

What Benchmark Offers

At Benchmark, you work on products that truly matter. We are an organization where you are given freedom, where entrepreneurship is valued, and where you can turn your ideas into reality. We offer a dynamic environment that enables you to grow quickly, take ownership, and make a real impact. You become part of a global company while still enjoying the pragmatic and down-to-earth culture that defines our Almelo site.

In addition, we offer:

  • Competitive salary: A monthly gross salary ranging from €5.281,- to €7.010,- based on a full-time employment contract, depending on your experience and educational background.

  • Quarterly bonus: Performance-based and linked to company results, with the opportunity to earn up to 5% of your quarterly salary.

  • Excellent time off package: Enjoy 40 days off per year, consisting of 27 vacation days and 13 ATV days.

  • Growth and development opportunities: Through our extensive Benchmark Academy training portfolio, as well as external courses and education programs aligned with both your ambitions and our business needs.

  • Flexible working hours: We value results over rigid schedules and offer flexibility in organizing your workday.

  • Collaborative learning culture: Through initiatives such as Lunch & Learn sessions, we encourage knowledge sharing across teams. Our Pitch Discovery Sessions provide dedicated space to explore your own ideas, experiment with new technologies, and drive innovation.

  • International high-tech environment: Work alongside talented colleagues across multiple disciplines and locations on complex and meaningful technology projects.

  • A culture of ownership and innovation: We encourage continuous improvement, initiative, and the freedom to influence how we work and develop solutions.

Interested?

We are looking for colleagues who can shape the future with us, inspire themselves and others with innovative technologies, take on new challenges, and develop forward-looking solutions. Does this sound like you?

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. You have contributed to improving testability and automated verification strategies, actively participate in code reviews, and help raise software quality standards.

After your first year, you will own significant nontrivial features and parts of the code-base of the team.
